description: Get the risk view of one XLS-33 Multi-Purpose Token issuance before touching it: what the issuer CAN DO to a holder (clawback, freeze, require-auth, whether it's transferable at all) plus the issuer's XRPLScore. Free. For the full issuer picture — account age, xrp-ledger.toml-verified domain, credentials held, Bithomp cross-check — GET /api/x402/usdc/mpt/{id} pays $0.01 USDC on Base via x402. Every response states its source and returns 'unknown', never 'does not exist', when an issuance isn't found. Params: issuance_id (48-hex MPTokenIssuanceID, required). No signup.
name: check_mpt_risk
